quarterly_data.signal: Inventec MOPS filing: the board approved on 07-28-2026, for US subsidiary Inventec (USA) Corp, an additional purchase of the east-side plant at Park 1099, 23623 Colonial Parkway, Katy, Texas (land about 1,524,600 square feet; plant building 236,986 square feet; US$58 million) plus power works of US$48.6 million; counterparties include Yacoel 2021 Partners, LP and Katy Mission, LLC, CTCI Americas Inc. and CenterPoint Energy, Inc. (not related parties). The filing says this follows the 03-10-2026 approval to convert the leased plant from lease to purchase, and that, given long-term business development and power needs, Inventec is buying the additional east-side land and plant and adding investment in power infrastructure to raise the factory's production capacity.
